result.title: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
result.summary: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 VMSA 框架处理长视频问答：构建片段字幕、实体事件、实体感知片段三类互补外部视频记忆作为检索证据源，并从成功 agent 轨迹中归纳「记忆技能」，指导迭代式证据检索、推理与验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「选哪个记忆源、何时停止检索并验证」的决策与技能库式轨迹监督，可供核查与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 策略及证据筛选的联系，但推理状态仍为外部文本记忆而非 latent 表示，需读原文确认成本与跨间隔证据连接的实现。
